findings.summary: Preventive PBC ($30M gene editing raise, Nov 2025) — Mulherin-led personal investment predating Structure Fund formation
findings.detail: Oliver Mulherin and Sam Altman backed Preventive PBC (San Francisco), a gene editing startup targeting embryonic hereditary disease prevention. Preventive raised ~$30M from private funders (~November 2025). Mulherin stated he was the 'driving force' behind the Preventive investment. The timing (Nov 2025) predates Structure Fund's formal incorporation (Dec 19, 2025), suggesting Preventive was invested personally or through a prior SPV — not through Structure Fund I LP. The Preventive investment and the fund's formation are consistent with Mulherin formalizing a biotech investment practice.

findings.summary: Altman and Mulherin backed Preventive gene-editing startup ($30M) in November 2025 — Mulherin made public investment statement
findings.detail: Sam Altman and Oliver Mulherin are confirmed investors in Preventive (preventive.bio), a San Francisco public benefit corporation focused on embryo gene editing to prevent hereditary diseases. Raised ~$30M. Founder: Lucas Harrington (PhD from Jennifer Doudna lab; co-founder Mammoth Biosciences). Co-investor: Brian Armstrong (Coinbase CEO). Mulherin stated: 'I chose to invest in Preventive because I care about research that helps people avoid disease.' Investment announced November 2025, before Structure Fund I GP formal incorporation (December 2025) — vehicle unclear. Gene editing in embryos is illegal in US/UK; Preventive reportedly evaluating UAE for clinical testing.

findings.summary: Structure Fund I LP led $37M Centivax financing round in March 2026 — first confirmed public investment by Mulherin-managed fund
findings.detail: Structure Fund (Oliver Mulherin & Sam Altman) led a $37 million oversubscribed financing for Centivax, a South San Francisco-based universal flu vaccine developer (CEO Jacob Glanville). Co-investors: Meiji Seika Pharma Co. Ltd. (Japan), Sigmas Group, Kendall Capital Partners, and Stripe co-founders Patrick and John Collison. Centivax total raised: $133M. Phase 2 trials scheduled early 2027. This is the first publicly confirmed deployment of Structure Fund capital.

The Collisons are among the most prominent figures in Silicon Valley tech and have prior connections to Altman through Y Combinator and OpenAI ecosystems.
